title: Machine Learning-Based Classification of Gastric, Breast, and Head and Neck Cancers: A Comparative Study Using Common Epidemiological Risk Factors

contributions.purpose: 评比 5 种 ML 算法对三类癌症的分类能力
contributions.mechanism: 590 样本 6 个流行病学特征,SMOTE 平衡+标准化,5 折交叉验证跑 LR/RF/SVM/NB/KNN
contributions.evaluation: Random Forest 最优:准确率 69.62%±4.14%,F1 69.68%;LR 最差 52.87%
contributions.source_quote: Random Forest achieved the highest performance with an accuracy of 69.62% ± 4.14%, precision of 71.05% ± 3.95%, recall of 69.62% ± 4.14%, and F1-score of 69.68% ± 4.18%.

contributions.purpose: 识别区分三类癌症的关键流行病学预测因子
contributions.mechanism: 分析 Random Forest 特征重要性
contributions.evaluation: Khuva(传统烟草)与 Snuff 为最重要预测因子,Khuva-Snuff 相关性最强(r=0.451)
contributions.source_quote: Random Forest's feature importance revealed that Khuva (traditional tobacco) and Snuff consumption were the most significant predictors, followed by Smoking and Smoked Food consumption.

notes: desk-reject。质量存疑:三类癌症(胃/乳腺/头颈)共享同一组烟草/饮食风险因子做多分类在流行病学上牵强,乳腺癌与烟草关联薄弱;最优准确率仅 69.62%(接近三分类基线 33% 之上但对医学诊断偏弱,属弱结果),作者自承'epidemiological factors alone may be insufficient'。方法学隐患:先 SMOTE 生成合成样本再做交叉验证有数据泄漏风险(合成样本可能同时落入训练/验证)。特征名 Khuva/Tuibur 具地域文化特异性(疑印度东北部咀嚼烟草),泛化性差。PDF 中未见 Agents4Science AI 参与度 checklist。无 self-declared provenance。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+results 归纳。
